name: Jongmin Choi
title: MS Student in Multimodal AI
university: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
bio:
I am an MS student in the Multimodal AI (MMAI) Lab at KAIST, advised by Professor Joon Son Chung. My research asks two questions: how neural networks should compute, and how different modalities should meet inside a single model.

Along these lines, I have worked on interpretable spiking neurons for Spiking Neural Networks and on mitigating the audio–text modality gap in multimodal representation learning (both completed). I am currently designing connectors that effectively bridge audio encoders and language-model decoders in Audio Language Models, and exploring optimization algorithms for training deep networks. I am always open to discussing research ideas and potential collaborations — feel free to reach out!
